name: BCH Nostr ID
description: Link a Bitcoin Cash address to a Nostr key with NIP-39: the address proves itself by spending a coin into an OP_RETURN that carries the verification text for the npub.

holder.name: Identity holder
holder.description: Holds the key of the identity address.

fund.name: Fund identity address
fund.description: Receive coins at an identity address.

holder.name: Receive
holder.description: Receive coins at the identity address.

funder.name: Send
funder.description: Send coins to the identity address.

linkNostrKey.name: Link Nostr key
linkNostrKey.description: Prove that this address links to the Nostr key $(<nostrNpub>).

revokeNostrLink.name: Revoke Nostr link
revokeNostrLink.description: Revoke this address link to the Nostr key $(<nostrNpub>).

fundTransaction.name: Funded
fundTransaction.description: Coins received at an identity address.

revokeTransaction.name: Nostr link revoked
revokeTransaction.description: This address no longer links to $(<nostrNpub>).

identityInput.name: Identity coin
identityInput.description: A coin of the identity address; spending it is the proof of control.

identityLockingScript.name: Identity address
identityLockingScript.description: An address that can link itself to a Nostr key.

linkRecordLockingScript.name: NIP-39 proof
linkRecordLockingScript.description: OP_RETURN with the NIP-39 verification text.

scripts.linkRecord: OP_RETURN <"nip39"> <$(<"Verifying that I control the following Nostr public key: "> <nostrNpub> OP_CAT)>
scripts.revokeRecord: OP_RETURN <"nip39"> <$(<"Revoking my link to the following Nostr public key: "> <nostrNpub> OP_CAT)>

holderKey.name: Identity Key
holderKey.description: The key of the identity address.

transferredSatoshis.name: Amount
transferredSatoshis.description: Satoshis sent to the identity address.

nostrNpub.name: Nostr key
nostrNpub.description: The npub (bech32, npub1...) of the Nostr key to link.
